- load_cell_power_supply_type: value "DC"

Actually wait — maybe simpler to just keep one characteristic: load_cell_power_supply with value "5 V DC / 12 V DC". Fidelity over structure for odd cases. But the strict rule says separate value and unit. I'll go with the split approach.
